latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of linkedin-video-dl

- Download LinkedIn videos from public post URLs without authentication.
- Saves video files in MP4 format to the current directory with unique filenames.
- No external dependencies; built using Go's standard library.
- Includes download progress display and safe interruption handling.
- Skips download if the target file already exists.
